Ivy: Quick flag - new int8 candidate (qint8-nimble) shows a small but consistent rerank@1 drop on our short-instruct promptset (~3.2%).
Marco: Which slice? short-instruct or faq?
Ivy: short-instruct. Ran: `./eval_harness --model qint8-nimble --prompts promptsets/short_instruct_mar2026.json --metrics rerank@1,bert_score --out /tmp/qint8-nimble.json` 
Tara: before humans, run near-dupe and fingerprint. If many paraphrases got merged we might be seeing reorder noise.
Ivy: ran near-dupe: 4 exact dups, 6 high-sim (>0.9). Not enough to explain pattern.
Marco: ok create a micro-golden for the worst 75 diffs. @label-bot create-batch --name "qint8-nimble-75" --size 75 --golden true --owners Tara,Marco --priority high
label-bot: Batch qint8-nimble-75 queued. ETA ~10h. React :eyes: to allow senior auto-approve.
Ivy: also spinning up a 1% canary route pinned to qint8-nimble for short-instruct to collect live rerank telemetry. If micro-golden pass-rate < 0.975 or entailment delta > 0.03 we hold rollout. Owners: Ivy + Tara.
Marco: launch quant-sensitivity sweep toggling kv_cache,prefill_len,kernel_mode. If kernel_mode=fast shows issues we can force precise kernels for canary.
Tara: tagging promptset examples with metadata: ["qint8-nimble-investigation"], snapshot id snap-1778889990. Monitor label-bot and canary dashboard. :eyes:
